Reevaluate your model selection strategy, as Opus accounts for 89 percent of your usage while Haiku and Sonnet combined make up only 11 percent, driving your daily cost to $11.21 for a single git commit. 4. Restructure your workflow to align prompt complexity with model capability. Utilizing Opus for 89 percent of your operations while only yielding 1 local git commit indicates heavy experimentation or inefficient prompt engineering that can be streamlined with smaller models.

5. Monitor your session granularity by aiming for tighter, more focused interactions. Your current metrics show roughly 350,000 input tokens per session across 6 sessions, suggesting that conversational drift or failing to clear out stale context is severely bloating your token consumption.
